prompt: Write python code for displaying barplot of the lengths of the contents of the cells of a dataframe
response:
To display a barplot of the lengths of the contents of the cells in a dataframe, you can use the following code:
```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Assuming df is your DataFrame
df['length'] = df.apply(lambda row: len(row), axis=1)
df['length'].value_counts().sort_index().plot(kind='bar')
plt.xlabel('Length')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.title('Barplot of Cell Lengths')
plt.show()
```
This code first calculates the length of each cell's content and stores it in a new column 'length'. Then, it counts the frequency of each unique length and plots a barplot using matplotlib.
